title: Secretariat's Heart Weighed 22 Pounds, Nearly 3x a Normal Horse

scenes.text: Secretariat's heart weighed 22 pounds, nearly triple a normal horse's.
That's what the necropsy found after he died in 1989. A normal horse's heart weighs about eight and a half.
In 1973, he won the Belmont Stakes by 31 lengths.
That's roughly 80 yards ahead of the second horse.
He ran the mile and a half in two minutes, 24 seconds.
A 22-pound heart. Thirty-one lengths. Records that still stand.
